card.name: Words leading up to "conflict"
card.fires_on: Words just before the word "conflict" is expected, such as "are" or "in" in "are in conflict", and "conflict" used as a verb. It responds in general web text about clashing laws, rules, schedules or rights.

modes.label: Setup before "in conflict"
modes.description: Linking words after two things that are being set against each other, where "conflict" comes next.

modes.description: Words in a phrase that is about to name a conflict.

modes.label: The verb conflict itself
modes.description: The verb "conflict" when rights, rules or goals clash.
modes.example: positive rights of patients often<< conflict>> with negative rights of physicians.
